t: You are in Green Park, one of the Royal Parks of London, in the City of Westminster. It lies just north of Buckingham Palace, across Constitution Hill. It sits in the middle of an almost unbroken chain of green spaces that also includes St James's Park, Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. To the northeast is St James's, with Lancaster House, Clarence House and St James's Palace. Two people are recorded as dying here: the Whig politician William Lyttelton, third Baron Lyttelton, and the sculptor Agnes Freda Forres, who worked in bronze and plaster.
